entities.summary: Nicolai Gennadyevich Dubinin, is a Russian prelate of the Catholic Church as the Titular Bishop of Aquae in Byzacena and Auxiliary bishop of Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Mother of God at Moscow since 30 July 2020.
